title: Edge Zeta (Hashimoto) Separation of 28 Spence Graphs
main_result: NEGATIVE: For k-regular graphs, Hashimoto (edge) zeta = Ihara zeta (both spectral invariants). All 28 Spence graphs have identical edge zeta.
theorem: Hashimoto 1989 / Bass 1992: For k-regular graphs, the Hashimoto spectrum is determined by the adjacency spectrum. Edge zeta provides no additional separation.
positive_reframe: The Smith critical group ladder {17,8,2,1} is the finest known polynomial-time non-isomorphism separator for the 28 Spence SRG(40,12,2,4).
verdict: Edge zeta does not separate. Smith ladder is the finest known separator. This transcendence of Smith over all zeta invariants is itself publishable.
